1	/**
2	 * Custom esbuild bundler for the Cloudflare Worker.
3	 *
4	 * Wrangler's built-in esbuild cannot mark specific packages as external, so we
5	 * pre-bundle the worker here and point wrangler to the output with --no-bundle.
6	 *
7	 * Approach:
8	 *   - platform: "neutral" so esbuild doesn't inject browser/node polyfills
9	 *   - node:* builtins are external — provided at runtime by CF nodejs_compat
10	 *   - cloudflare:* modules are external — provided by the CF runtime
11	 *   - embedded-postgres / @embedded-postgres/* — native Node binaries, not available
12	 *     in Workers; no CF code path reaches these
13	 *   - jsdom — Node-only; SVG sanitization path (assets.ts) will throw at runtime in CF
14	 *   - node:sqlite — pulled in by undici@7 via jsdom; not available in Workers
15	 */
16	
17	import { build } from "esbuild";
18	import { fileURLToPath } from "url";
19	import path from "path";
20	
21	const __dirname = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
22	
23	// Node.js built-ins that CF provides via nodejs_compat flag
24	const NODE_BUILTINS = [
25	  "node:assert", "node:async_hooks", "node:buffer", "node:child_process",
26	  "node:cluster", "node:console", "node:constants", "node:crypto",
27	  "node:dgram", "node:diagnostics_channel", "node:dns", "node:domain",
28	  "node:events", "node:fs", "node:fs/promises", "node:http", "node:http2",
29	  "node:https", "node:inspector", "node:module", "node:net", "node:os",
30	  "node:path", "node:perf_hooks", "node:process", "node:querystring",
31	  "node:readline", "node:repl", "node:stream", "node:stream/consumers",
32	  "node:stream/promises", "node:stream/web", "node:string_decoder",
33	  "node:sys", "node:timers", "node:timers/promises", "node:tls",
34	  "node:trace_events", "node:tty", "node:url", "node:util", "node:util/types",
35	  "node:v8", "node:vm", "node:wasi", "node:worker_threads", "node:zlib",
36	  // Without "node:" prefix (legacy imports)
37	  "assert", "async_hooks", "buffer", "child_process", "cluster", "console",
38	  "constants", "crypto", "dgram", "diagnostics_channel", "dns", "domain",
39	  "events", "fs", "http", "http2", "https", "inspector", "module", "net",
40	  "os", "path", "perf_hooks", "process", "querystring", "readline", "repl",
41	  "stream", "string_decoder", "sys", "timers", "tls", "trace_events", "tty",
42	  "url", "util", "v8", "vm", "wasi", "worker_threads", "zlib",
43	  // Node 22.5+ built-in pulled in by undici@7 — not available in Workers
44	  "node:sqlite",
45	];
46	
47	await build({
48	  entryPoints: [path.join(__dirname, "src/worker/api.ts")],
49	  bundle: true,
50	  outfile: path.join(__dirname, "dist/worker.js"),
51	  format: "esm",
52	  target: "es2022",
53	  platform: "neutral",
54	  conditions: ["workerd", "worker", "browser", "module"],
55	  mainFields: ["module", "main"],
56	  external: [
57	    // CF runtime modules
58	    "cloudflare:*",
59	    // Node built-ins (provided by nodejs_compat)
60	    ...NODE_BUILTINS,
61	    // Node-only packages not available in CF Workers
62	    "embedded-postgres",
63	    "@embedded-postgres/*",
64	    "jsdom",
65	  ],
66	  alias: {
67	    // Replace Express (requires node:http) with a zero-dep CF-safe shim that
68	    // builds the same Router stack structure express-router-bridge expects.
69	    "express": path.join(__dirname, "src/http/cf-express-shim.ts"),
70	  },
71	  splitting: false,
72	  define: {
73	    "process.env.NODE_ENV": '"production"',
74	  },
75	  logLevel: "info",
76	});
77	
78	console.log("Worker bundle written to dist/worker.js");
79
